name: Base Dollar
oneLiner: BD is a pre-launch Liquity V2 fork on Base, designed as an overcollateralized dollar stablecoin minted against LP token collateral and earning AERO yield.
collateral: LP-collateralized stablecoin forking Liquity V2 on Base L2; yield generated from AERO farming, with revenue split between users, protocol-owned liquidity treasury, and BD stakers
pegMechanism: Liquity V2-style Base fork: BD is minted against LP token collateral and each BaseD stablecoin is designed to be redeemable for $1 of system collateral, with collateral redemption and borrower/liquidation incentives supporting the dollar peg

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver as no identified direct, upstream, or possible freeze exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: BD resolves to No because existing metadata does not identify direct, upstream, or possible freeze exposure.

launchPhaseDetail: Fork of Liquity V2 on Base; external security audit remediation merged through May 2026, with docs still describing audits as in progress. Deployed to Base Sepolia testnet in June 2026, then production contracts deployed to Base mainnet on August 1 2026 (BoldToken 0x252d36f435582ecb01686448d21e8c9ea0b2ca65, ~2,500 BD seeded) with the production frontend live at app.basedollar.org from August 3. No public launch announcement yet, docs do not yet publish contract addresses, and supply is team-seeded dust, so Pharos holds BD at launching-soon until a public launch is communicated.
